The mixed support matrix has negative-definite Schur complement -(n−1−k) and determinant magnitude n−1−k, bounding all denominators. For any 1<=r<=n−1, explicit D_r has Zariski negative part coefficient 1/r; added nef Q_r with square r(r+1)>0 gives a big witness. All negative-definite supports occur with big witnesses and count 2^(n+1)−n−1. Independent exact rational intersection checks cover n=3..25; analytic argument is all n.

originality.rationale: The full ar5iv text of Bauer–Pokora–Schmitz Example 3.4 establishes this precise collinear family and its maximal single denominator n-1. Its negative intersection support determinants have absolute values n-1-k, which imply the upper bound u(X_n)|lcm(1,...,n-1), but neither a greatest common clearing multiple nor witnesses for each intermediate r are stated. The submitted effective/big D_r constructions give exact reduced coefficients 1/r for all r and therefore the reverse divisibility. This produces the sharp least simultaneous denominator-clearing multiple; value is a natural all-divisor invariant, not generic larger maximum denominator.
